cost_limit: Current P commits an audit event and cursor revision for empty Publish. One-second idle probes can produce about 86400 audit events/day/Host. Retention, load limits and probe-path optimization remain incomplete.
limitations: Unqualified FILE_SIMULATION P-only restart; no physical equipment or active production recovery acceptance.
Evidence session/cell negotiation only: old operating HostRegistration, grant and all restrictions remain; explicit operating rebind/resume is incomplete.
OpenEvidenceProducer has no source-generation input. Source continuity is not judged; existing source fencing/fact invalidation remains.
Old sessions preceding more than the directly covered prior runtime require separate origin-chain/recovery analysis.
Read-only SQLite is a test oracle, not a new product control or support API.
R01–R30 remain in scope; no whole-product completion or clean whole-field shutdown claim.
